question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and is Mathematics (Course 18), and the minimum department budget code, ordered by department code, subject code, and subject number.
